name: verify-gate-all-feedback-scopes
body:
`apg plan verify <project>` must gate on every Feedback in the project's transient stores. Today `apg.plan_cmd.plan_verify_at` (src/plan_cmd.rs:1584–1721) loads only the plan store (`apg.plan_cmd.load_plan`, src/plan_cmd.rs:32–38) and scopes its unresolved-feedback check (src/plan_cmd.rs:1624–1645) to Plan/PlanPhase/Task targets; Feedback attached to a durable layer node or a code node lives in `.trans/<tier>/<project>.jsonl` and is invisible to the gate. The intended contract (test `apg.plan_cmd.tests.scoped_review_feedback_routes_and_gates_by_scope`, src/plan_cmd.rs:5378) is that the gate checks every scope; the data source is simply incomplete.

Contract: the gate requires every Feedback in the project's transient stores — the plan store plus the five tier mirrors (`apg.specs.project_transient_files`, src/specs.rs:159–179) — to be `resolved`, naming each unresolved feedback FQN. `apg plan complete` remains phase-scoped (it gates only the phase and its tasks).

Acceptance:
- With an `open`/`actioned` Feedback targeting a durable layer node (or a code node), `apg plan verify <project>` refuses and the error names that feedback FQN.
- Once every Feedback in the plan store and all five tier mirrors is `resolved`, `apg plan verify` passes (absent other blockers).
- `apg plan complete` is unchanged: it gates only the phase and its tasks.
